summary.text: Paul Bonzani is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 36, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the September 8 primary.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a Doctor of Occupational Therapy and an associate clinical professor of occupational therapy at the University of New Hampshire.

paragraphs.text: Bonzani earned a high school diploma from Xavier High School, a bachelor's degree from New York University in 1979 and a graduate degree from the University of Florida in 2007, with additional education from Creighton University in 2020, according to Ballotpedia.
In the survey, he said he has more than 35 years of clinical experience in health care service delivery and rehabilitation service management, and 11 years of academic experience.

Bonzani said property taxes are a central issue and that he would support restoring the Business Enterprise Tax rate to 0.60 percent while keeping the increased filing threshold, with the revenue designated for local municipal costs.
He also said he opposes uncapped school choice, describing it as a voucher program, and named tax and education policy and health care policy as his areas of passion.
He listed Rights and Democracy New Hampshire as an organization endorsing his campaign.
